SELECT schools.School,
       frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Eligible Free Rate (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation Education'
ORDER BY `Eligible Free Rate (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = '1'
  AND f."District Name" = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
ORDER BY s.Zip;

SELECT s.MailStreet
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T2.Phone
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
  AND T1."Charter Funding Type" = 'Directly funded'
  AND T2.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath > 400
  AND schools.Virtual = 'F';

SELECT satscores.sname
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND schools.Magnet = 1

SELECT T1.Phone
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
ORDER BY T2.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(s.`NumTstTakr`) AS num_sat_test_takers
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.`CDSCode` = s.`cds`
WHERE f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` = (
    SELECT MAX(`FRPM Count (K-12)`)
    FROM frpm
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT schools.CDSCode)
FROM satscores
INNER JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath > 560
  AND schools.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE "Enrollment (K-12)" + "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500;

SELECT MAX(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" * 1.0 / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS highest_free_rate
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores AS sa
JOIN schools AS s ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY CAST(sa.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / sa.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.School, s.NCESSchool
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.dname AS district_name
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.dname
ORDER BY AVG(s.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND s.County = 'Alameda'
  AND t.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    s.sname,
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    sc.CharterNum,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS ranking
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode)
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Fresno'
  AND s.FundingType = 'Directly Funded'
  AND t.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT sc.Phone
FROM satscores sa
JOIN schools sc ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY sa.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode)
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Amador'
  AND `Low Grade` = '9'
  AND `High Grade` = '12';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode)
FROM frpm
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500
  AND "FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700;

SELECT sname, NumTstTakr
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE ABS(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30;

SELECT DISTINCT satscores.sname
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE frpm.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND satscores.NumGE1500 > 0

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(t.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT DISTINCT
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800
  AND f."High Grade" = '12';

SELECT satscores.sname,
       AVG(satscores.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_writing_score,
       schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', schools.OpenDate) AS INTEGER) > 1991
   OR (schools.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL
       AND CAST(strftime('%Y', schools.ClosedDate) AS INTEGER) < 2000)
GROUP BY satscores.cds, satscores.sname, schools.Phone;

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
  AND T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > (
      SELECT AVG(`Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm
      WHERE `Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
  )

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Low Grade` = 'K' AND f.`High Grade` = '12'
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City, f."Enrollment (K-12)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL AND `Enrollment (K-12)` > 0
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT schools.School,
       frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_frpm_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOC = '66'
  AND frpm.`Low Grade` = '1'
  AND frpm.`High Grade` = '12'
ORDER BY frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT schools.School, schools.Website
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000;

SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS FreeRate
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE (schools.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND schools.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson')
   OR (schools.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND schools.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson')
   OR (schools.AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND schools.AdmLName3 = 'Gibson');

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH TopSchool AS (
    SELECT s.AdmFName1 AS f1, s.AdmLName1 AS l1,
           s.AdmFName2 AS f2, s.AdmLName2 AS l2,
           s.AdmFName3 AS f3, s.AdmLName3 AS l3
    FROM satscores st
    JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
    ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT f1 || ' ' || l1 AS FullName
FROM TopSchool
WHERE f1 IS NOT NULL AND l1 IS NOT NULL AND f1 <> '' AND l1 <> ''
UNION
SELECT f2 || ' ' || l2
FROM TopSchool
WHERE f2 IS NOT NULL AND l2 IS NOT NULL AND f2 <> '' AND l2 <> ''
UNION
SELECT f3 || ' ' || l3
FROM TopSchool
WHERE f3 IS NOT NULL AND l3 IS NOT NULL AND f3 <> '' AND l3 <> '';

SELECT sch.Street, sch.City, sch.Zip, sch.State
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools sch ON sat.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sat.NumTstTakr IS NOT NULL AND sat.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / sat.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT schools.Website
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000
  AND schools.County = 'Los Angeles';

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr) AS avg_num_test_takers
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Fresno'
  AND YEAR(sc.OpenDate) = 1980;

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sname
FROM (
    SELECT sc.sname,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sc.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
    FROM satscores sc
    JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
) ranked
WHERE rnk <= 5;

SELECT schools.EILName
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AvgScrMath, cname
FROM satscores
ORDER BY AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.AvgScrWrite, sc.City
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.sname AS School, AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS AverageWritingScore
FROM schools sc
JOIN satscores s ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE (sc.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (sc.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (sc.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich')
GROUP BY s.cds, s.sname
ORDER BY s.sname;

SELECT s.School, f."Enrollment (K-12)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / 12 AS monthly_average
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = 52
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN DOC = '54' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) /
    NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN DOC = '52' THEN 1 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND County = 'Orange';

SELECT County, School, ClosedDate
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
  AND County = (
    SELECT County
    FROM schools
    WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY County
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT s.sname, sc.MailStreet
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT s.sname, sc.MailStreet
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT schools.CDSCode)
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport'
  AND satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite >= 1500;

SELECT SUM(s.NumTstTakr) AS total_test_takers
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.MailCity = 'Fresno';

SELECT School, MailZip
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName1 = 'Atoian')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName2 = 'Atoian')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName3 = 'Atoian');

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Colusa' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
    SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Humboldt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE MailState = 'CA';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailState = 'CA' AND StatusType = 'Active' AND City = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT s.Phone, s.Ext
FROM satscores sa
JOIN schools s ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY sa.AvgScrWrite DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332;
SELECT School, Phone, Ext FROM schools WHERE Zip = '95203-3704'

SELECT DISTINCT Website
FROM schools
WHERE AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 IN ('Mike Larson', 'Dante Alvarez')
   OR AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 IN ('Mike Larson', 'Dante Alvarez')
   OR AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 IN ('Mike Larson', 'Dante Alvarez');
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND County = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.Charter = 0
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18;

SELECT
    School,
    City,
    AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS Administrator1,
    AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 AS Administrator2,
    AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 AS Administrator3
FROM schools
WHERE Charter = 1
  AND CharterNum = '00D2'
ORDER BY School;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE County = 'Stanislaus' 
  AND FundingType = 'Directly Funded' 
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2000' AND '12/31/2005'
SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) FROM schools WHERE City = 'San Francisco' AND DOCType = 'Community College District' AND ClosedDate IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) = '1989'

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND ClosedDate IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT NCESDist FROM schools WHERE SOC = 31

SELECT StatusType, COUNT(CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alpine'
  AND SOCType = 'District Community Day School'
GROUP BY StatusType;

SELECT DISTINCT frpm."District Code"
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.City = 'Fresno'
  AND schools.Magnet = 0;

SELECT f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Fremont'
  AND s.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'
  AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015';

SELECT frpm."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.DOCType = 'Youth Authority School'
  AND schools.MailStreet = 'PO Box 1040';

SELECT frpm.`Low Grade`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.NCESDist = '0613360'
  AND schools.EdOpsCode = 'SPECON'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT schools.EILName, schools.School
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm."NSLP Provision Status" = '2'
  AND frpm."County Code" = '37';

SELECT schools.City
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`NSLP Provision Status` = '2'
  AND frpm.`Low Grade` = '9'
  AND frpm.`High Grade` = '12'
  AND frpm.`County Name` = 'Merced'
  AND schools.EILCode = 'HS'

SELECT "School Name",
       "FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100.0 / "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND "Low Grade" = 'K'
  AND "High Grade" = '9';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT County, COUNT(CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
  AND Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY num_schools DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.`School Type`,
       schools.School,
       schools.Latitude
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.Latitude IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY schools.Latitude DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City, f.`Low Grade`, s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 'Magnet K-8 schools with Multiple Provision Types' AS City,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
UNION ALL
SELECT City,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE GSserved = 'K-8'
GROUP BY City
ORDER BY num_schools DESC;

SELECT fname AS FirstName, District, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS fname, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName1) != ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName2) != ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName3) != ''
) AS admins
GROUP BY fname, District
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT frpm.`District Code`,
       frpm.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'
   OR schools.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine'
   OR schools.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine';

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m-%d', OpenDate) BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND SOC = 62
  AND DOC = 54
  AND AdmEmail1 IS NOT NULL AND AdmEmail1 LIKE '%@%'
  AND AdmEmail2 IS NOT NULL AND AdmEmail2 LIKE '%@%'
  AND AdmEmail3 IS NOT NULL AND AdmEmail3 LIKE '%@%';

SELECT sc.AdmEmail1, s.sname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DisplayName, Reputation
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName = 'Harlan' OR DisplayName = 'Jarrod Dixon'
ORDER BY Reputation DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE LastAccessDate > '2014-09-01'
SELECT DisplayName FROM users ORDER BY Views DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(Id)
FROM users
WHERE UpVotes > 100
  AND DownVotes > 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE Views > 10 AND YEAR(CreationDate) > 2013;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS post_count
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT posts.Title
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT users.DisplayName
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE posts.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts';

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
ORDER BY p.FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(p.CommentCount) AS TotalComments
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT p.AnswerCount
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
ORDER BY p.AnswerCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT users.DisplayName
FROM posts
JOIN users ON users.Id = posts.LastEditorUserId
WHERE posts.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(p.Id)
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
  AND p.ParentId IS NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT users.DisplayName
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE posts.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM posts 
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id 
WHERE users.Age > 65 
  AND posts.Score >= 20;

SELECT users.Location
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE posts.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts';

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON tags.ExcerptPostId = posts.Id
WHERE tags.TagName = 'bayesian';

SELECT p.Body
FROM tags t
JOIN posts p ON t.ExcerptPostId = p.Id
ORDER BY t.Count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(b.Id) AS BadgeCount
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT DISTINCT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
ORDER BY b.Name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS BadgeCount
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
  AND YEAR(badges.Date) = 2011;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
GROUP BY b.UserId, u.DisplayName
ORDER BY COUNT(b.Id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(badges.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(users.DisplayName) AS average_badges
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.Views > 200;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN users.Age > 65 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(posts.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE posts.Score > 5;
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM votes WHERE UserId = 58 AND CreationDate = '2010-07-19'

SELECT CreationDate
FROM votes
GROUP BY CreationDate
ORDER BY Count(Id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Revival';

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE c.Score = (SELECT MAX(Score) FROM comments);

SELECT COUNT(c.Id) AS CommentCount
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ViewCount = 1910;

SELECT p.FavoriteCount
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE c.UserId = 3025
  AND c.CreationDate = '2014-04-23 20:29:39.0'

SELECT c.Text
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ParentId = 107829
  AND p.CommentCount = 1
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.Id,

        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y
        ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
lowest_per_segment AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        CustomerID,
        total_consumption
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Segment,
            CustomerID,
            total_consumption,
            MIN(total_consumption) OVER (PARTITION BY Segment) AS min_consumption
        FROM per_customer
    ) t
    WHERE total_consumption = min_consumption
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_per_segment
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM segment_avg;

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS pct_change
    FROM seg
)
(
    SELECT Segment, pct_change, 'Biggest increase' AS category
    FROM pct
    ORDER BY pct_change DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
UNION ALL
(
    SELECT Segment, pct_change, 'Lowest increase' AS category
    FROM pct
    ORDER BY pct_change ASC
    LIMIT 1
);

JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'

  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district);

    WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target)
      AND t.date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1

      AND t.date = '1998-12-27'

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 t
    JOIN min_per_segment m 
        ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
        (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
        (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
        (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS pct_increase
    FROM seg
)
SELECT Segment, pct_increase
FROM pct
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MAX(pct_increase) FROM pct)

FROM Player p

FROM Player p

FROM Player_Attributes pa

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id)

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match JOIN Country ON Match.country_id = Country.id WHERE Country.name = 'Belgium' AND Match.season = '2008/2009';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match AS M JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id WHERE L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND SUBSTR(M.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04';

SELECT SUM(T1.overall_rating) / COUNT(T1.id) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.birthday) < '1986';

SELECT (t1.overall_rating - t2.overall_rating) * 100.0 / t2.overall_rating AS percentage_higher
FROM
  (SELECT pa.overall_rating
   FROM Player p
   JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
   WHERE p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk'
   LIMIT 1) t1,
  (SELECT pa.overall_rating
   FROM Player p
   JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
   WHERE p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'
   LIMIT 1) t2;
SELECT AVG(TA.buildUpPlaySpeed) FROM Team AS T JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Heart of Midlothian'
SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Pietro Marino'
SELECT SUM(T1.crossing) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Aaron Lennox'

SELECT T1.preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo'
SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon'

SELECT TA.chanceCreationCrossingClass

SELECT TA.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' AND substr(pa.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

SELECT
  (
    (SELECT pa.overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
       AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%')
    -
    (SELECT pa.overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
       AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%')

  (SELECT pa.overall_rating
   FROM Player_Attributes pa
   JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
   WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
     AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%') AS percentage;

FROM Player p
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
JOIN Match AS M ON P.player_api_id IN (
    M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
    M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
    M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5,
    M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country AS C ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name AS country
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT country_id, player_api_id
    FROM (
        SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
    ) m
) pm
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pm.player_api_id
JOIN Country c ON c.id = pm.country_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

WITH italy_matches AS (
    SELECT * FROM Match
    WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Italy')
),
italy_player_ids AS (
    SELECT home_player_1 AS pid FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_2 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_3 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_4 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_5 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_6 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_7 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_8 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_9 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_1 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_2 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_3 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_4 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_5 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_6 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_7 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_8 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_9 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM italy_matches
)
SELECT AVG(p.height) AS avg_height
FROM Player p
JOIN italy_player_ids i ON p.player_api_id = i.pid
WHERE i.pid IS NOT NULL;
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name ASC LIMIT 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990';
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS jumping_difference;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'
ORDER BY potential ASC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes) AND preferred_foot = 'left'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN strength > 80 AND stamina > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes;
SELECT Country.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT T1.team_long_name AS home_team,
       T2.team_long_name AS away_team,
       M.home_team_goal,
       M.away_team_goal
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Team AS T1 ON M.home_team_api_id = T1.team_api_id
JOIN Team AS T2 ON M.away_team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE M.date LIKE '2008-09-24%'
  AND L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT PA.sprint_speed, PA.agility, PA.acceleration
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';

SELECT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_games
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND l.name = 'Italy Serie A';
SELECT MAX(M.home_team_goal) FROM Match M JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id WHERE L.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie'

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);
SELECT League.name FROM League JOIN Match ON League.id = Match.league_id WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY League.name ORDER BY COUNT(Match.id) DESC LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Match AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match);

FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' 
  AND district.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) 
FROM account a 
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id 
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague' 
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END FROM district

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.district_id) 
FROM client c 
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id 
WHERE c.gender = 'F' 
  AND d.A11 > 6000 
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - A11 AS gap
FROM (
    SELECT a.account_id AS account_id, d.A11 AS A11
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
    ORDER BY d.A11 ASC
    LIMIT 1
) t;

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id
JOIN district AS T4 ON T3.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T3.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND T4.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'DISPONENT'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.status = 'A'
  AND (T2.date LIKE '97%' OR T2.date LIKE '1997%')
  AND T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

LIMIT 1;

FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND a.date LIKE '1993%'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'

FROM trans
WHERE date >= '1995-01-01'
  AND date < '1996-01-01'
  AND date = (
        SELECT MIN(date)
        FROM trans
        WHERE date >= '1995-01-01'
          AND date < '1996-01-01'

FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE account.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND loan.amount > 3000;

SELECT d.client_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT account.date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840 AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT account.district_id
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id

FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id

JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id

FROM trans t
WHERE t.account_id = (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    ORDER BY amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND t.date >= (
    SELECT date
    FROM account
    WHERE account_id = (
        SELECT account_id
        FROM loan
        ORDER BY amount DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
)
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id

SELECT d.disp_id
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id

JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id

FROM client c
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id

FROM account

    FROM trans t
    JOIN target ON t.account_id = target.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
b1998 AS (

    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'

    WHEN 'o'  THEN 'Oxygen'
    WHEN 's'  THEN 'Sulfur'
    WHEN 'n'  THEN 'Nitrogen'
    WHEN 'p'  THEN 'Phosphorus'
    WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
    WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'

    WHEN 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
    WHEN 'pb' THEN 'Lead'
    WHEN 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
    WHEN 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
    ELSE a1.element

  CASE a2.element
    WHEN 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'

    WHEN 'i'  THEN 'Iodine'
    WHEN 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
    WHEN 'pb' THEN 'Lead'
    WHEN 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
    WHEN 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
    ELSE a2.element
  END AS element_of_atom_2

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN segment_min sm ON ct.Segment = sm.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH cons AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
  SELECT Segment,
         (c2013 - c2012) * 100.0 / c2013 AS pct_increase
  FROM cons
)
SELECT Segment, pct_increase
FROM pct
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MAX(pct_increase) FROM pct)
   OR pct_increase = (SELECT MIN(pct_increase) FROM pct)
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC;

JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Price = 548.4;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS percentage
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';

SELECT GasStationID
FROM transactions_1k
GROUP BY GasStationID
ORDER BY SUM(Amount * Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(Price) AS total_spent, SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '201201%' THEN Price ELSE 0 END) AS spent_january_2012 FROM transactions_1k WHERE CustomerID = 38508;

SELECT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.Description
ORDER BY SUM(t.Amount) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Currency, SUM(t.Price) AS TotalSpent, SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AvgPricePerItem
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.ProductID = 2
ORDER BY t.Price / t.Amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CustomerID, Consumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE Date = '201208'
  AND CustomerID IN (
      SELECT CustomerID
      FROM transactions_1k
      WHERE ProductID = 5
        AND Price / Amount > 29.00
  );
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes ORDER BY overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT player_name, MAX(height) AS height FROM Player;
SELECT preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes ORDER BY potential ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE overall_rating >= 60 AND overall_rating < 65 AND defensive_work_rate = 'low';
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY player_api_id ORDER BY MAX(crossing) DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT L.name
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY SUM(M.home_team_goal + M.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T.team_long_name, COUNT(*) AS lost_matches
FROM Match M
JOIN Team T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
  AND M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal < 0
GROUP BY T.team_api_id, T.team_long_name
ORDER BY lost_matches ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(pa.penalties) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Team T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND M.season = '2009/2010'
  AND M.away_team_goal > M.home_team_goal
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id

SELECT
  (
    (SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating)
     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk')
    -
    (SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating)
     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel')
  ) * 100.0 /
  (
    SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'
  ) AS percentage_higher;

JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR124'
SELECT atom_id, element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR186';
SELECT bond_type FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR007_4_19';

SELECT
  CASE a.element
    WHEN 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'
    WHEN 'c' THEN 'Carbon'
    WHEN 'h' THEN 'Hydrogen'
    WHEN 'o' THEN 'Oxygen'
    WHEN 's' THEN 'Sulfur'
    WHEN 'n' THEN 'Nitrogen'
    WHEN 'p' THEN 'Phosphorus'
    WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
    WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'
    WHEN 'f' THEN 'Fluorine'
    WHEN 'i' THEN 'Iodine'
    WHEN 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
    WHEN 'pb' THEN 'Lead'
    WHEN 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
    WHEN 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
    ELSE a.element
  END AS element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'
UNION
SELECT
  CASE a.element
    WHEN 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'
    WHEN 'c' THEN 'Carbon'
    WHEN 'h' THEN 'Hydrogen'
    WHEN 'o' THEN 'Oxygen'
    WHEN 's' THEN 'Sulfur'
    WHEN 'n' THEN 'Nitrogen'
    WHEN 'p' THEN 'Phosphorus'
    WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
    WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'
    WHEN 'f' THEN 'Fluorine'
    WHEN 'i' THEN 'Iodine'
    WHEN 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
    WHEN 'pb' THEN 'Lead'
    WHEN 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
    WHEN 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
    ELSE a.element
  END
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, m.label AS carcinogenic FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = ' WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT m.molecule_id, a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id, b.bond_type, a1.element AS atom1, a2.element AS atom2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
);

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id) AS bond_type_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS molecules_with_double_bond, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_molecules FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's')

SELECT m.label

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR001';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a

JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, c.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM seg
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_low AS (
    SELECT s.Segment AS Segment, SUM(s.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(s.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM seg AS s
    JOIN lowest AS l ON s.Segment = l.Segment AND s.total_consumption = l.min_consumption
    GROUP BY s.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_low WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_low WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_low WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_low WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM;

WITH pct AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
            - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
           / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, Percentage
FROM pct
WHERE Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM pct)
   OR Percentage = (SELECT MIN(Percentage) FROM pct);

FROM trans AS T1
INNER JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.date = '1998-12-27'
  AND T2.date = '1993-03-22'
  AND T1.account_id = (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05' AND status = 'C'

  );

WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT cc.Segment, MIN(cc.total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT cc.Segment,
           SUM(cc.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(cc.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    JOIN min_consumption mc
      ON cc.Segment = mc.Segment
     AND cc.total_consumption = mc.min_total
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM segment_avg;

WITH gas_stats AS (
    SELECT
        t.GasStationID,
        AVG(t.Amount * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.Price, 0)) AS value_ratio
    FROM transactions_1k t
    GROUP BY t.GasStationID
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        gs.GasStationID,
        gs.value_ratio,
        AVG(gs.value_ratio) OVER () AS overall_avg_ratio
    FROM gas_stats gs
)
SELECT
    g.Country,
    COUNT(*) AS TotalValueForMoneyStations
FROM ranked r
JOIN gasstations g
    ON g.GasStationID = r.GasStationID
WHERE r.value_ratio > r.overall_avg_ratio
GROUP BY g.Country
ORDER BY TotalValueForMoneyStations DESC;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) -
    (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district
     WHERE district_id IN (
         SELECT district_id
         FROM client
         WHERE gender = 'F'
           AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
     )
    ) AS salary_gap
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_id IN (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id IN (
        SELECT client_id
        FROM client
        WHERE gender = 'F'
          AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
          AND district_id IN (
              SELECT district_id
              FROM district
              WHERE A11 = (
                  SELECT MIN(A11)
                  FROM district
                  WHERE district_id IN (
                      SELECT district_id
                      FROM client
                      WHERE gender = 'F'
                        AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
                  )
              )
          )
    )
);

JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY MAX(e.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN (SELECT AVG(cost) AS avg_cost FROM expense) a ON e.cost > a.avg_cost;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN z.state = 'New Jersey' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(m.member_id)
     - 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN z.state = 'Vermont' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(m.member_id) AS percentage_difference
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.position = 'Member';

SELECT major.major_name, major.department

         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN p.ID END)

    ELSE 'more outpatient'
  END AS more_frequent,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN p.ID END) * 100.0 /
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN p.ID END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient p
INNER JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M';
