SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND E.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND YEAR(Patient.`First Date`) < 2000;

SELECT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY p.`First Date` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.SSB IN ('-', '+-')
  AND e.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSB IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Laboratory.SSB IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE DNA >= 8
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Laboratory 
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.IGG > 900 
  AND Laboratory.IGG < 2000 
  AND Patient.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 
       / COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60 THEN Laboratory.ID END) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.GOT < 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`GOT` >= 60;

SELECT p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GPT < 60
ORDER BY l.GPT DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS male_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GOT < 60
  AND p.SEX = 'M';

SELECT P.`First Date`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
ORDER BY L.LDH DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(T1.Date)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
WHERE T1.ID = (
    SELECT T2.ID
    FROM Patient AS T2
    WHERE T2."First Date" = (
        SELECT MAX(T3."First Date")
        FROM Patient AS T3
        WHERE T3.ID IN (
            SELECT ID
            FROM Laboratory
            WHERE LDH >= 500
        )
    )
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALP >= 300
  AND p.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-' AND l.ALP < 300;

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TP < 6.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND l.TP > 6.0
  AND l.TP < 8.5;

SELECT T1.Date
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ALB > 3.5 AND T1.ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY T1.ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.ALB > 3.5
  AND Laboratory.ALB < 5.5
  AND Laboratory.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT e.`aCL IgG`, e.`aCL IgM`, e.`aCL IgA`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.50
ORDER BY l.UA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT Laboratory.ID
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY Examination."aCL IgA" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND Examination.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT E.ANA
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` < 2.0
ORDER BY L.`T-BIL` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`T-CHO` >= 250
  AND T2.KCT = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` < 250
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.TG < 200
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT t1.ID
FROM Examination AS t1
JOIN Laboratory AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID
WHERE t1.Thrombosis = 0 AND t2.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.CPK < 250
  AND (E.KCT = '+' OR E.RVVT = '+' OR E.LAC = '+');

SELECT MIN(P.Birthday)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU > 180;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.GLU < 180 AND e.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '+'
  AND Laboratory.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Laboratory.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT DISTINCT Laboratory.ID
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE (Laboratory.RBC <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.RBC >= 6.0)
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.PLT > 100
  AND T2.PLT < 400
  AND T1.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL;

SELECT l.PLT
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.PLT > 100 AND l.PLT < 400
  AND p.Diagnosis = 'MCTD';

SELECT AVG(l.PT) AS average_prothrombin_time
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis IN (1, 2)
  AND l.PT < 14;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS avg_oxygen_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(T2.bond_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+' AND T2.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'na'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage_carbon
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_id) AS triple_bond_count
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element != 'br';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c';

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'h'
GROUP BY m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(m.label) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl';

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1_id, a1.element AS atom1_element,
       a2.atom_id AS atom2_id, a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(a.element) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE (c.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20')
   OR (c.atom_id = 'TR004_20' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8');

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND a.element = 'sn'
WHERE a.atom_id IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element IN ('i', 's')
  AND bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN c.atom_id = a1.atom_id THEN c.atom_id2
        ELSE c.atom_id
    END AS connected_atom_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c
    ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a1.atom_id
WHERE a1.molecule_id = 'TR181';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.element IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'f'
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(b.bond_type = '#') * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id) AS percent
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element
LIMIT 3;

SELECT a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_6'
  AND b.molecule_id = 'TR001';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_2_5';

SELECT DISTINCT c2.bond_id
FROM connected c1
JOIN connected c2 ON c1.atom_id2 = c2.atom_id2
WHERE c1.atom_id = 'TR000_2';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
ORDER BY m.label
LIMIT 5;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR008';

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(a.element = 'h') * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id), 4) AS percent
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR206';

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT a.element, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR060';

SELECT b.bond_type, m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND bond.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY b.bond_id
LIMIT 2;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR009'
  AND (c.atom_id = 'TR009_12' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR009_12');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS carcinogenic_with_bromine
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'br';

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(T1.bond_id) AS num_connections
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T2.atom_id LIKE 'TR%_19';

SELECT a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id, b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n')
   OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p');

SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM molecule
    WHERE molecule_id = (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
        GROUP BY molecule_id
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
      AND label = '+'
) AS is_carcinogenic;

SELECT COUNT(T2.bond_id) / COUNT(T1.atom_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'i';

SELECT T2.bond_type, T1.bond_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, 7, 2) + 0 = 45;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
LEFT JOIN connected c1 ON a.atom_id = c1.atom_id
LEFT JOIN connected c2 ON a.atom_id = c2.atom_id2
WHERE c1.atom_id IS NULL AND c2.atom_id2 IS NULL;

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19';

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT (COUNT(c.bond_id) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(c.bond_id)) OVER ()) AS percentage
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(c.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS total_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element IN ('c', 'h');

SELECT c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 's';

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'sn';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS total_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN atom e ON e.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND e.element IN ('p', 'br');

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT SUM(atom.element = 'cl') * 1.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percent
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) AS total_carcinogenic_molecules
FROM molecule
WHERE label = '+'
  AND molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR030';

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR050';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'i';

SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(m.label) = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT CASE 
    WHEN (a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c') 
      OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl') 
    THEN 'yes' 
    ELSE 'no' 
END AS result
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type = '#'
  AND a.element = 'c'
LIMIT 2;

SELECT SUM(atom.element = 'cl') * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR001';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT m.label,
       SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.element) AS ratio
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label;
SELECT T2.label FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'ca'

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c';

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percent_triple_bond
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT SUM(b.bond_type = ' = ') / COUNT(b.bond_id) AS percent
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_1';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR151';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR151' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS carcinogenic_compounds
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND substr(molecule.molecule_id, 3, 3) >= 10
  AND substr(molecule.molecule_id, 3, 3) <= 50;

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'h' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T3.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR186';

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR007_4_19';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM bond
   WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
     AND bond_type = ' = ') AS double_bond_count,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT label
          FROM molecule
          WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006') = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
    ELSE 'non-carcinogenic'
  END AS carcinogenic_status;

SELECT m.molecule_id, a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id, b.bond_id, a1.element AS atom1, a2.element AS atom2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS bond_type_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS molecules_with_double_bond,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element != 's' AND T3.bond_type != ' = ';

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR001';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM bond 
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4';

SELECT bond.bond_type
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE connected.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
  AND connected.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a1
JOIN atom a2 ON a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
JOIN molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' ELSE 'Non-carcinogenic' END AS status
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS num_carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'n';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.molecule_id) > 5;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR024'
  AND b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY num_atoms DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(m.label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'h'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS carcinogenic_molecules
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS num_molecules_with_single_bonds
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010'
  AND b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_carbons
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR008'
  AND a.element = 'c';

SELECT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR004_7' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT a.element, b.bond_type
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR012'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND a.element = 'c';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND atom.element = 'o';

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` 
FROM frpm 
WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation' 
ORDER BY `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` ASC 
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T2.Zip
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND T1.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
SELECT MailStreet FROM schools WHERE CDSCode = (SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm ORDER BY `FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND T1.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly Funded'
  AND T2.OpenDate > '2000-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores 
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath > 400 AND schools.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT T1.sname
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.NumTstTakr
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.`FRPM Count (K-12)` = (
    SELECT MAX(`FRPM Count (K-12)`)
    FROM frpm
);

SELECT COUNT(T2.School)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath > 560 AND T2.FundingType = 'Directly Funded'

SELECT frpm."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM satscores
JOIN frpm ON satscores.cds = frpm.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT MAX(frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.NumGE1500 / satscores.NumTstTakr > 0.3

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 / T1.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T2.School, T2.NCESSchool
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT T2.District
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T2.District
ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT s.sname, sc.CharterNum, s.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT COUNT(satscores.cds)
FROM satscores
INNER JOIN frpm ON satscores.cds = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE frpm."County Name" = 'Fresno'
  AND frpm."Charter Funding Type" = 'Directly Funded'
  AND satscores.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE "County Name" = 'Amador' 
  AND "Low Grade" = 9 
  AND "High Grade" = 12;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' 
  AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 
  AND "FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700;
SELECT T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 WHERE T1.cname = 'Contra Costa' ORDER BY T1.NumTstTakr DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.Zip, T2.State
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND s.NumGE1500 > 0

SELECT T1.sname, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.City = 'Riverside' AND T1.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Monterey'
  AND T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND T2.GSserved = '9-12'

SELECT T1.sname, T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.OpenDate) > '1991'
   OR STRFTIME('%Y', T2.ClosedDate) < '2000';

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOC
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > (
    SELECT AVG(`Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
)

SELECT T2.OpenDate
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT schools.City
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
GROUP BY schools.City
ORDER BY SUM(frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)`) ASC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Eligible FRPM Rate (K-12)`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.DOC = '66'
ORDER BY frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T2.Website, T1.`School Name`
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` 
FROM schools AS T1 
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1, s.AdmFName2, s.AdmLName2, s.AdmFName3, s.AdmLName3
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(st.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / st.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Website
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T1.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) 
FROM satscores AS T1 
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980' AND T2.County = 'Fresno'

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT sname
FROM (
    SELECT s.sname,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.County ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
    FROM satscores s
    JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE sc.Virtual = 'F'
) t
WHERE rnk <= 5;

SELECT T2.EILName
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AvgScrMath, cname
FROM satscores
ORDER BY AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.School, T1.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE (T2.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND T2.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (T2.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND T2.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (T2.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND T2.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich')

SELECT T2.School 
FROM frpm AS T1 
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T2.DOC = 31 
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12 AS monthly_average
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = 52
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT s.County, s.School, s.ClosedDate
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS num_closed
    FROM schools
    WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY County
    ORDER BY num_closed DESC
    LIMIT 1
) t ON s.County = t.County
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Closed';

SELECT T1.sname, T2.MailStreet
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

SELECT schools.MailStreet, schools.School
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) 
FROM schools AS T1 
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds 
WHERE T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrWrite >= 1500 
  AND T1.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

SELECT SUM(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.MailCity = 'Fresno';

SELECT School, MailZip 
FROM schools 
WHERE (AdmFName1 = "Avetik" AND AdmLName1 = "Atoian") 
   OR (AdmFName2 = "Avetik" AND AdmLName2 = "Atoian") 
   OR (AdmFName3 = "Avetik" AND AdmLName3 = "Atoian");
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Colusa' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Humboldt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM schools WHERE MailState = 'CA'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE MailState = 'CA' 
  AND StatusType = 'Active' 
  AND City = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT T2.Phone, T2.Ext
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332;
SELECT Phone, Ext, School FROM schools WHERE Zip = '95203-3704';

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')

WITH czk2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, y.Consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM czk2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT z.Segment, z.CustomerID, z.Consumption
    FROM czk2013 z
    JOIN segment_min m
      ON m.Segment = z.Segment AND m.MinConsumption = z.Consumption
),
avg_cons AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           SUM(Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH consumption_by_segment AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
percentage_change AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2013 AS pct_increase
    FROM consumption_by_segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM percentage_change ORDER BY pct_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS Biggest_Increase,
    (SELECT Segment FROM percentage_change ORDER BY pct_increase ASC LIMIT 1) AS Lowest_Increase;

WITH annual AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS annual_total
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_annual AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(annual_total) AS min_total
    FROM annual
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_annual AS (
    SELECT a.Segment AS Segment, SUM(a.annual_total) / COUNT(a.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM annual a
    JOIN min_annual m ON a.Segment = m.Segment AND a.annual_total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY a.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_annual WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_annual WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_annual WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_annual WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_annual WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_annual WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS s2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS s2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (s2013 - s2012) AS Increase,
           (s2013 - s2012) * 100.0 / s2013 AS Pct
    FROM yearly
)
SELECT p.Segment, p.Increase, p.Pct
FROM pct p
WHERE p.Pct = (SELECT MAX(Pct) FROM pct)
   OR p.Pct = (SELECT MIN(Pct) FROM pct);

JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Aaron Doran';

SELECT DISTINCT Player.player_name
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player_Attributes.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast';

SELECT Team_Attributes.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_short_name = 'CLB'
SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name FROM Team AS T JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE TA.buildUpPlayPassing > 70

SELECT SUM(t2.overall_rating) / COUNT(t2.id)
FROM Player_Attributes AS t2
JOIN Player AS t1 ON t2.player_api_id = t1.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', t2.date) >= '2010' AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) <= '2015'
  AND t1.height > 170;
SELECT P.player_name FROM Player P JOIN (SELECT MIN(height) AS min_height FROM Player) M ON P.height = M.min_height;
SELECT Country.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeed = 31
  AND TA.buildUpPlayDribbling = 53
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing = 32;

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Doran';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE League.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga' AND strftime('%Y-%m', Match.date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10'
SELECT T.team_short_name FROM Match AS M JOIN Team AS T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id WHERE M.home_team_goal = 10

SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE player_api_id IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE potential = 61 AND balance = (SELECT MAX(balance) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE potential = 61))

SELECT team_long_name FROM Team WHERE team_short_name = 'GEN'
SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 JOIN (SELECT MAX(height) AS max_height FROM Player) AS T2 ON T1.height = T2.max_height
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.player_api_id) FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.preferred_foot = 'left' AND T2.attacking_work_rate = 'low'

SELECT League.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE Country.name = 'Germany';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.player_api_id)

SELECT COUNT(M.id) FROM Match AS M JOIN Country AS C ON M.country_id = C.id WHERE C.name = 'Belgium' AND M.season = '2008/2009';

SELECT pa.long_passing

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match AS T1 JOIN League AS T2 ON T1.league_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND SUBSTR(T1.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04'

SELECT L.name AS league_name
FROM League AS L

SELECT SUM(T1.overall_rating) / COUNT(T1.id) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.birthday) < '1986'

SELECT ((a.overall_rating - b.overall_rating) * 100.0) / b.overall_rating AS percentage_higher
FROM
  (SELECT pa.overall_rating
   FROM Player p
   JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
   WHERE p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk'
   ORDER BY pa.date DESC
   LIMIT 1) a,
  (SELECT pa.overall_rating
   FROM Player p
   JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
   WHERE p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'
   ORDER BY pa.date DESC
   LIMIT 1) b;
SELECT AVG(TA.buildUpPlaySpeed) FROM Team T JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Heart of Midlothian'

SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating)
FROM Player AS T2

SELECT PA.preferred_foot

SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon'
SELECT AVG(m.away_team_goal) FROM Match AS m JOIN Team AS t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id JOIN Country AS c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Parma' AND c.name = 'Italy';

SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' AND SUBSTR(T1.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

SELECT ((ld.overall_rating - jb.overall_rating) * 100.0 / ld.overall_rating) AS percentage
FROM (SELECT pa.overall_rating
      FROM Player p
      JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
      WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
        AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%') ld
CROSS JOIN (SELECT pa.overall_rating
            FROM Player p
            JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
            WHERE p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
              AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%') jb;

SELECT SUM(T1.home_team_goal) FROM Match AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.home_player_1 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_2 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_3 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_4 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_5 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_6 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_7 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_8 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_9 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_10 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_11 = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon'

SELECT SUM(m.away_team_goal)
FROM Match m
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)

SELECT SUM(t.home_team_goal) AS total_home_team_goal
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.home_team_goal
    FROM Match AS m
    INNER JOIN Player AS p
        ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3,
                               m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6,
                               m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9,
                               m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11)
    WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) AS INTEGER)
           - CAST(strftime('%Y', datetime(p.birthday)) AS INTEGER)) < 31
) AS t;

FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id)
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague' AND loan.status IN ('A', 'C');
SELECT AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995, AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996, CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_percentage_year FROM district

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'M' AND district.A3 = 'north Bohemia' AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT T3.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - MIN(T4.A11) AS gap
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
JOIN district AS T4 ON T1.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
  AND T1.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND T4.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11)
                FROM district
                WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id
                                      FROM client
                                      WHERE gender = 'F'
                                        AND birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')))
GROUP BY T3.account_id;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
JOIN (SELECT MAX(birth_date) AS youngest_birth FROM client) y ON c.birth_date = y.youngest_birth
JOIN (SELECT MAX(A11) AS max_salary FROM district) s ON di.A11 = s.max_salary;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT client.client_id
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND disp.type = 'DISPONENT';

WITH admin_names AS (
    -- Stack all three administrator first-name columns into one list,
    -- keeping the district each administrator belongs to
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
),
top_two AS (
    -- Find the two most frequent first names
    SELECT first_name
    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY first_name
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT an.first_name,
       an.District,
       COUNT(*) AS num_administrators
FROM admin_names AS an
JOIN top_two AS t
    ON an.first_name = t.first_name
GROUP BY an.first_name, an.District
ORDER BY an.first_name, num_administrators DESC;

SELECT
    -- Difference 1: SME's annual average - LAM's annual average
    (SELECT SUM(Consumption) / COUNT(customerid)
     FROM yearmonth
     WHERE customerid IN (SELECT customerid
                          FROM customers
                          WHERE currency = 'CZK' AND segment = 'SME')
       AND date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  - (SELECT SUM(Consumption) / COUNT(customerid)
     FROM yearmonth
     WHERE customerid IN (SELECT customerid
                          FROM customers
                          WHERE currency = 'CZK' AND segment = 'LAM')
       AND date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS difference_SME_LAM,

    -- Difference 2: LAM's annual average - KAM's annual average
    (SELECT SUM(Consumption) / COUNT(customerid)
     FROM yearmonth
     WHERE customerid IN (SELECT customerid
                          FROM customers
                          WHERE currency = 'CZK' AND segment = 'LAM')
       AND date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  - (SELECT SUM(Consumption) / COUNT(customerid)
     FROM yearmonth
     WHERE customerid IN (SELECT customerid
                          FROM customers
                          WHERE currency = 'CZK' AND segment = 'KAM')
       AND date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS difference_LAM_KAM,

    -- Difference 3: KAM's annual average - SME's annual average
    (SELECT SUM(Consumption) / COUNT(customerid)
     FROM yearmonth
     WHERE customerid IN (SELECT customerid
                          FROM customers
                          WHERE currency = 'CZK' AND segment = 'KAM')
       AND date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  - (SELECT SUM(Consumption) / COUNT(customerid)
     FROM yearmonth
     WHERE customerid IN (SELECT customerid
                          FROM customers
                          WHERE currency = 'CZK' AND segment = 'SME')
       AND date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS difference_KAM_SME;

SELECT c.Segment,
       (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(t.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN t.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(t.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN t.Consumption ELSE 0 END))
        * 100.0
        / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(t.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN t.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS PercentageIncrease
FROM yearmonth AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND substr(t.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY PercentageIncrease DESC;

SELECT SUM(cost) / COUNT(event_id)
FROM expense
JOIN budget ON expense.link_to_budget = budget.budget_id
JOIN event  ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE member.position != 'Member';

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN expense ex ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget
WHERE b.category = 'Parking'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING SUM(ex.cost) < (
    SELECT SUM(ex2.cost) / COUNT(e2.event_id)
    FROM event e2
    JOIN budget b2 ON e2.event_id = b2.link_to_event
    JOIN expense ex2 ON b2.budget_id = ex2.link_to_budget
    WHERE b2.category = 'Parking'
);

SELECT

    SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013,
    SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) 
       - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
    , 2) AS percentage_increase
FROM yearmonth AS ym
JOIN customers AS c 
    ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC;

    l.status,

WITH CustomerConsumption AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
MinPerSegment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM CustomerConsumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
AnnualAvg AS (
    SELECT cc.Segment,
           SUM(cc.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAverage
    FROM CustomerConsumption cc
    JOIN MinPerSegment m
      ON cc.Segment = m.Segment
     AND cc.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM AnnualAvg WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM AnnualAvg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM AnnualAvg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM AnnualAvg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM AnnualAvg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM AnnualAvg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH yearly AS (
    -- Total consumption per segment for 2012 and 2013 (EUR-paying customers only)
    SELECT
        c.Segment AS Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    -- Percentage of increase = (2013 consumption - 2012 consumption) / 2013 consumption * 100
    SELECT
        Segment,
        (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / cons_2013 AS pct_increase
    FROM yearly
),
biggest AS (
    SELECT Segment, pct_increase FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase DESC LIMIT 1
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT Segment, pct_increase FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase ASC  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT Segment, pct_increase FROM biggest
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment, pct_increase FROM lowest;

JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.type = 'Social'
  AND e.location = '900 E. Washington St.'
  AND m.position = 'Vice President';

SELECT T1.last_name, T1.position
FROM member AS T1
JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.expense_description = 'Pizza'
  AND T2.expense_date = '2019-09-10';

SELECT DISTINCT member.last_name
FROM member
JOIN attendance ON member.member_id = attendance.link_to_member
JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE member.position = 'Member'
  AND event.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN income.amount = 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       * 100 / COUNT(member.member_id) AS percentage
FROM member
JOIN income 
    ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'
  AND member.position = 'Member';

SELECT zip_code
FROM zip_code
WHERE type = 'PO Box'
  AND county = 'San Juan Municipio'
  AND state = 'Puerto Rico';

SELECT event_name
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Game'
  AND status = 'Closed'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20';

SELECT DISTINCT e.event_id
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN expense AS ex ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget
WHERE ex.cost > 50;

SELECT 
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    e.event_name,
    a.link_to_event
FROM expense AS ex
JOIN member AS m 
    ON ex.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN attendance AS a 
    ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN event AS e 
    ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE ex.approved = 'true'
  AND ex.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT major.college
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Katy'
  AND member.link_to_major = 'rec1N0upiVLy5esTO';

SELECT m.phone
FROM member AS m
JOIN major AS mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Business'
  AND mj.college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences';

SELECT DISTINCT member.email
FROM member
JOIN expense ON member.member_id = expense.link_to_member
WHERE expense.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'
  AND expense.cost > 20;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_members
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.remaining < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 
       / COUNT(e.event_id) AS percentage
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event;

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT SUM(type = 'PO Box') * 100.0 / COUNT(zip_code) AS percentage_po_box
FROM zip_code;

SELECT e.event_name, e.location
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE b.remaining > 0;

SELECT e.event_name, e.event_date
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN expense ex ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget
WHERE ex.expense_description = 'Pizza'
  AND ex.cost > 50
  AND ex.cost < 100;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    ma.major_name
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE e.cost > 100;

SELECT z.city, z.county
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN member m     ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN income i     ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN zip_code z   ON z.zip_code = m.zip
GROUP BY e.event_id
HAVING COUNT(i.income_id) > 40;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN budget b  ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.link_to_event) > 1
ORDER BY SUM(e.cost) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense AS e
JOIN member AS m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event AS ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT T2.event_name
FROM event AS T2
JOIN budget AS T3 ON T2.event_id = T3.link_to_event
JOIN expense AS T4 ON T3.budget_id = T4.link_to_budget
WHERE T3.category = 'Parking'
GROUP BY T2.event_id, T2.event_name
HAVING SUM(T4.cost) < (
    SELECT SUM(T5.cost) / COUNT(DISTINCT T6.link_to_event)
    FROM expense AS T5
    JOIN budget AS T6 ON T5.link_to_budget = T6.budget_id
    WHERE T6.category = 'Parking'
);

SELECT CAST(SUM(T3.cost) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.event_id) * 100 AS percentage
FROM event AS T1
JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget
WHERE T1.type = 'Meeting';

SELECT T1.category
FROM budget AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.budget_id = T2.link_to_budget
WHERE T2.expense_description = 'Water, chips, cookies'
ORDER BY T2.cost DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT member.first_name, member.last_name
FROM member
JOIN expense ON member.member_id = expense.link_to_member
GROUP BY member.member_id, member.first_name, member.last_name
ORDER BY MAX(expense.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    m.phone
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e 
    ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

SELECT 
    (SUM(z.state = 'New Jersey') * 100.0 / COUNT(m.position = 'Member'))
    -
    (SUM(z.state = 'Vermont') * 100.0 / COUNT(m.position = 'Member')) 
    AS percentage_difference
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code;

SELECT major.major_name, major.department
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Garrett' AND member.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, e.cost
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies';

SELECT 
    member.last_name,
    member.phone
FROM member
JOIN major 
    ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id

SELECT 
    b.category,
    b.amount
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'January Speaker';

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE b.category = 'Food';

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T2.amount
FROM member AS T1
JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.date_received = '2019-09-09';

SELECT budget.category
FROM expense
JOIN budget ON expense.link_to_budget = budget.budget_id

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, ma.college
FROM member AS m
JOIN major AS ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id

SELECT 
    e.event_name,
    SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name;

SELECT T2.city
FROM member AS T1
JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code

SELECT 
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    m.position
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code

WITH admins AS (
    -- Combine all administrator first names into one column,
    -- keeping track of which district each administrator works in
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS FirstName, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2 AS FirstName, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3 AS FirstName, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
),
top_names AS (
    -- Find the two most frequent administrator first names overall
    SELECT FirstName, COUNT(*) AS freq
    FROM admins
    GROUP BY FirstName
    ORDER BY freq DESC
    LIMIT 2
)
-- Show each of the top two names along with the district(s) they administer in
SELECT a.FirstName,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.District) AS Districts
FROM admins a
JOIN top_names t ON a.FirstName = t.FirstName
GROUP BY a.FirstName;

WITH annual AS (                       -- per-customer total consumption in 2013 (CZK customers only)
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
lowest AS (                            -- lowest annual consumption value per segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM annual
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (                           -- annual average of the customers tied at the lowest consumption
    SELECT a.Segment,
           SUM(a.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM annual a
    JOIN lowest l
      ON l.Segment = a.Segment
     AND l.min_consumption = a.total_consumption
    GROUP BY a.Segment
)
SELECT (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
     - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
       (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
     - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
       (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
     - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT

    SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
    SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013,
    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
       - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END))
        * 100.0
        / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END),
        2
    ) AS pct_change
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c
    ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'                     -- only consumption paid in EUR
  AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')     -- the three segments of interest
  AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY pct_change DESC;

SELECT 
    ( 
      /* Ariel Borysiuk's most recent overall rating */
      (SELECT pa.overall_rating
       FROM Player p
       JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
       WHERE p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk'
       ORDER BY pa.date DESC
       LIMIT 1)
      -
      /* Paulin Puel's most recent overall rating */
      (SELECT pa.overall_rating
       FROM Player p
       JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
       WHERE p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'
       ORDER BY pa.date DESC
       LIMIT 1)
    )
    * 100.0
    /
    /* Divide by Paulin Puel's rating (the baseline) */
    (SELECT pa.overall_rating
     FROM Player p
