      OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_5
      OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_6
      OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_7
      OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_8
      OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_9
      OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_10
      OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_11);

SELECT SUM(m.away_team_goal) AS total_away_goals
FROM Match AS m
JOIN Player AS p1
    ON p1.player_name = 'Daan Smith'
JOIN Player AS p2
    ON p2.player_name = 'Filipe Ferreira'
WHERE p1.player_api_id IN (m.away_player_1,  m.away_player_2,  m.away_player_3,
                           m.away_player_4,  m.away_player_5,  m.away_player_6,
                           m.away_player_7,  m.away_player_8,  m.away_player_9,
                           m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
  AND p2.player_api_id IN (m.away_player_1,  m.away_player_2,  m.away_player_3,
                           m.away_player_4,  m.away_player_5,  m.away_player_6,
                           m.away_player_7,  m.away_player_8,  m.away_player_9,
                           m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11);

WITH players_30_or_below AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    WHERE CAST((julianday(datetime('now', 'localtime')) - julianday(birthday)) / 365.25
               AS INTEGER) <= 30          -- age 30 or below, i.e. < 31 years old
)
SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal) AS total_home_team_goals
FROM Match AS m
INNER JOIN players_30_or_below AS p1  ON m.home_player_1  = p1.player_api_id
INNER JOIN players_30_or_below AS p2  ON m.home_player_2  = p2.player_api_id
INNER JOIN players_30_or_below AS p3  ON m.home_player_3  = p3.player_api_id
INNER JOIN players_30_or_below AS p4  ON m.home_player_4  = p4.player_api_id
INNER JOIN players_30_or_below AS p5  ON m.home_player_5  = p5.player_api_id
INNER JOIN players_30_or_below AS p6  ON m.home_player_6  = p6.player_api_id
INNER JOIN players_30_or_below AS p7  ON m.home_player_7  = p7.player_api_id
INNER JOIN players_30_or_below AS p8  ON m.home_player_8  = p8.player_api_id
INNER JOIN players_30_or_below AS p9  ON m.home_player_9  = p9.player_api_id
INNER JOIN players_30_or_below AS p10 ON m.home_player_10 = p10.player_api_id
INNER JOIN players_30_or_below AS p11 ON m.home_player_11 = p11.player_api_id;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
GROUP BY P.player_api_id, P.player_name
HAVING MAX(PA.overall_rating) = (
    SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
    FROM Player_Attributes
);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2
  ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.finishing = 1
ORDER BY julianday(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime') - julianday(T1.birthday) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M
  ON P.player_api_id IN (
       M.home_player_1,  M.home_player_2,  M.home_player_3,  M.home_player_4,
       M.home_player_5,  M.home_player_6,  M.home_player_7,  M.home_player_8,
       M.home_player_9,  M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
       M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,
       M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,
       M.away_player_9,  M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
     )
JOIN Country AS C
  ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT 
    p.player_name, 
    c.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p 
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
JOIN Match m 
    ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,  m.home_player_4,  m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6,  m.home_player_7,  m.home_player_8,  m.home_player_9,  m.home_player_10,
        m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1,  m.away_player_2,  m.away_player_3,  m.away_player_4,
        m.away_player_5,  m.away_player_6,  m.away_player_7,  m.away_player_8,  m.away_player_9,
        m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country c 
    ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE pa.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name AS country,
       AVG(pc.weight) AS avg_weight
FROM Country c
JOIN (
    -- link each player to the country(es) they played in via matches
    SELECT DISTINCT m.country_id, p.player_api_id, p.weight
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Player p
      ON p.player_api_id IN (
           m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,  m.home_player_4,
           m.home_player_5,  m.home_player_6,  m.home_player_7,  m.home_player_8,
           m.home_player_9,  m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
           m.away_player_1,  m.away_player_2,  m.away_player_3,  m.away_player_4,
           m.away_player_5,  m.away_player_6,  m.away_player_7,  m.away_player_8,
           m.away_player_9,  m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
         )
) pc ON pc.country_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(pc.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

SELECT AVG(T1.height)
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Match AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.home_player_1
JOIN Country AS T3 ON T2.country_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.name = 'Italy';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_players
FROM Player
WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'
  AND birthday > '1990';

SELECT id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'
ORDER BY potential ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(id)
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes)
  AND preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT 
    m.home_team_goal,
    m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%'
  AND l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT 
    pa.sprint_speed,
    pa.agility,
    pa.acceleration
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';

SELECT T.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS T
JOIN Team AS Tm ON T.team_api_id = Tm.team_api_id
WHERE Tm.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_games
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A'
  AND Match.season = '2015/2016';

SELECT MAX(M.home_team_goal) AS highest_home_team_score
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie';

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);

SELECT 
    League.name AS league_name,
    COUNT(Match.id) AS num_games
FROM League
JOIN Match ON League.id = Match.league_id
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY League.name
ORDER BY num_games DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Match AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (
    SELECT MAX(away_team_goal)
    FROM Match
);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
ORDER BY PA.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN P.height < 180 AND PA.overall_rating > 70 
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(PA.id) AS percentage
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l     ON l.account_id  = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        ELSE '1996'
    END AS higher_unemployment_year,
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d 
    ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

WITH oldest_female_birth AS (
    -- Step 1: birth date of the oldest female client
    SELECT MIN(birth_date) AS oldest_birth
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
),
oldest_females AS (
    -- Step 2: the oldest female client(s) with their district's average salary (A11)
    SELECT c.client_id, d.A11
    FROM client c
    JOIN oldest_female_birth b 
        ON c.birth_date = b.oldest_birth
    JOIN district d 
        ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
target AS (
    -- Step 3: among the oldest female client(s), the one(s) with the lowest average salary
    SELECT client_id, A11
    FROM oldest_females
    WHERE A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM oldest_females)
)
-- Step 4: get her account number(s) and compute the gap
SELECT DISTINCT 
       a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - t.A11 AS gap
FROM target t
JOIN disp    ON disp.client_id = t.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id  = disp.account_id;

SELECT A.account_id
FROM account A
JOIN disp D     ON A.account_id = D.account_id
JOIN client C   ON D.client_id  = C.client_id
JOIN district T ON C.district_id = T.district_id
WHERE C.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND T.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'DISPONENT'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'C'                      -- 'C' = approved loan (running, no problems)
  AND l.date LIKE '1997%'                 -- loan taken/approved in 1997
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'      -- weekly issuance statement
ORDER BY l.amount ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 
    ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.duration > 12
  AND T2.status = 'C'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1993'
ORDER BY T2.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id) AS num_female_customers
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN account ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND client.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND district.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT t.account_id,
       MIN(t.date) AS earliest_trade_date
FROM trans t
GROUP BY t.account_id
HAVING strftime('%Y', MIN(t.date)) = '1995'
ORDER BY earliest_trade_date;

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT d.client_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT account.date AS account_open_date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT account.district_id
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.date = '1994-08-25';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS biggest_transaction_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d     ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a  ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount AS first_transaction_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d    ON d.account_id = l.account_id     -- link the client to the loan account
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id    -- get the account opening date
JOIN trans t   ON t.account_id = a.account_id     -- transactions on that account
WHERE l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan)   -- the biggest loan
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'                            -- the client who applied for the loan
  AND t.date >= a.date                            -- transaction made after the account was opened
ORDER BY t.date ASC                               -- earliest transaction first
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_clients
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A2 = 'Jesenik'
  AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT d.disp_id
FROM disp d
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 5100
  AND t.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1996';

SELECT district.A2
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND client.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT client.birth_date
FROM loan
JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE loan.amount = 98832
  AND loan.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS male_client_percentage
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY d.A4 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT 
    (t_end.balance - t_start.balance) * 100.0 / t_start.balance AS increase_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN trans t_start 
     ON t_start.account_id = l.account_id 
    AND t_start.date = '1993-03-22'
JOIN trans t_end 
     ON t_end.account_id = l.account_id 
    AND t_end.date = '1998-12-27'
WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
ORDER BY l.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage
FROM loan
WHERE amount < 100000;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS district_region
FROM account a
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';

SELECT a.account_id, a.date
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = '4990';

SELECT 
    loan.account_id,
    district.A2 AS district,
    district.A3 AS region
FROM loan
JOIN account 
    ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district 
    ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.amount > 300000;

SELECT l.loan_id, d.A3, d.A11
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT DISTINCT
       district.A2 AS district_name,
       district.A3 AS state,
       ((district.A13 - district.A12) / district.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_pct
FROM loan
JOIN account  ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.status = 'D';

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN district d 
    ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp 
    ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY num_female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS account_holders_without_card
FROM client c
JOIN district d  ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp     ON dp.client_id  = c.client_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'South Bohemia'          -- region of the client
  AND dp.type = 'OWNER'               -- only actual account holders
  AND NOT EXISTS (                    -- no card linked to any of their disp records
      SELECT 1
      FROM disp dp2
      JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = dp2.disp_id
      WHERE dp2.client_id = c.client_id
  );

SELECT d.A3 AS district_name
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')          -- 'C' = running contract, 'D' = running contract, client in debt
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT 
    district_id AS branch_location,
    A2          AS district_name
FROM district
WHERE A13 = (
    SELECT MAX(A13)
    FROM district
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts_opened
FROM account
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A16 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.balance < 0
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C')
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_male_clients
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_gold_owner_cards
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT AVG(monthly_amount) AS avg_credit_card_amount_per_month
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%m', date) AS month,
           SUM(amount)          AS monthly_amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2021'
    GROUP BY strftime('%m', date)
) AS monthly_totals;

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS d 
    ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'          -- credit card withdrawal
  AND t.date LIKE '1998%'                   -- restrict to year 1998
  AND t.amount < (
        SELECT AVG(t2.amount)
        FROM trans AS t2
        WHERE t2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
          AND t2.date LIKE '1998%'          -- average of 1998 card transactions
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date
FROM client c
JOIN disp    d  ON d.client_id  = c.client_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT connected.bond_id) AS num_bonds

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS num_molecules

  AND a.element = 'br';

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2

WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT

        ELSE 'Not Carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m

SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1

WHERE SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25'

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id, b.bond_type

JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

SELECT m.label = '+' AS is_carcinogenic

    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(T1.bond_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.atom_id) AS avg_bonds
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'i';

SELECT T1.bond_type, T1.bond_id

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c

  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT T1.element, T2.element
FROM connected AS T3
JOIN atom AS T1 ON T3.atom_id = T1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T3.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
WHERE T3.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19';

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_double_bonds
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' 
  AND b.bond_type = '='
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY num_double_bonds DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T3.atom_id

JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb'
  AND T3.atom_id2 != T1.atom_id;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond),
       2) AS percentage
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
         / COUNT(b.bond_id),
         5
       ) AS pct_carcinogenic_single_bonds
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m
  ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 's';

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'sn';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) AS num_elements
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_atoms

      )

          SELECT a2.molecule_id

      );

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b

WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
    * 100 / COUNT(T1.atom_id) AS percent
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T3.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) AS total_carcinogenic_molecules
FROM molecule
WHERE label = '+'
  AND molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR030';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS num_bonds
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'i';

SELECT MAX(label) AS majority_label

SELECT CASE

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id

  AND b.bond_type = '#'    -- triple bonds

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(atom.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2

WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a1.element AS element_1, a2.element AS element_2

JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id)
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' 
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id

SELECT

SELECT

  AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'

SELECT

JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM bond b

JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM bond AS b

JOIN atom AS a1      ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2      ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT 100.0 *
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id)
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = '#')

       (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM molecule) AS percent_triple_bond;

SELECT

SELECT m.label,

SELECT a.element

SELECT atom_id

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT b.bond_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count

SELECT T2.molecule_id

SELECT a.atom_id

SELECT a1.element, a2.element

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element

SELECT b.bond_id,

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c

SELECT

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT m.label

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id

SELECT b.bond_type

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS num_carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules

SELECT T1.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS num_molecules

SELECT COUNT(*)

WITH customer_totals AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per CZK-paying customer, per segment
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
segment_minimum AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption in each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_average AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of lowest-consumption customer(s) / count of those customer(s)
    SELECT
        ct.Segment,
        SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_average
    FROM customer_totals AS ct
    INNER JOIN segment_minimum AS sm
        ON ct.Segment = sm.Segment
       AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH segment_pct AS (

        (SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)

        / SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, Percentage
FROM segment_pct
WHERE Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM segment_pct)
   OR Percentage = (SELECT MIN(Percentage) FROM segment_pct)
ORDER BY Percentage DESC;

WITH MinConsumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        MIN(y.Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
AnnualAverage AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) / COUNT(y.CustomerID) AS annual_avg_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    INNER JOIN MinConsumption AS m
        ON c.Segment = m.Segment
       AND y.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS difference_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS difference_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS difference_KAM_SME;

FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon';

SELECT AVG(m.away_team_goal) AS average_away_goals
FROM Match m
JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Parma'
  AND c.name = 'Italy';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = 77
  AND PA.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY P.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT pa.overall_rating
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy'
  AND pa.date LIKE '2016-02-04%';

SELECT Player_Attributes.potential
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Francesco Parravicini'
  AND Player_Attributes.date = '2010-08-30 00:00:00';

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT T2.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'
  AND T2.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT pa.date
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND pa.crossing = (
      SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing)
      FROM Player_Attributes pa2
      JOIN Player p2 ON pa2.player_api_id = p2.player_api_id
      WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  )
ORDER BY pa.date
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Willem II'
  AND ta.date = '2012-02-22';

SELECT TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_short_name = 'LEI'
  AND TA.date = '2015-09-10 00:00:00';

SELECT TA.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes TA
JOIN Team T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient'
  AND TA.date LIKE '2010-02-22%';

SELECT TA.chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'PEC Zwolle'
  AND TA.date = '2013-09-20 00:00:00';

SELECT TA.chanceCreationCrossingClass
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hull City'
  AND TA.date = '2010-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT TA.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'
  AND TA.date LIKE '2015-09-10%';

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
  AND SUBSTR(pa.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT (PA1.overall_rating - PA2.overall_rating) * 100.0 / PA1.overall_rating AS percentage
FROM Player P1
JOIN Player_Attributes PA1 ON P1.player_api_id = PA1.player_api_id
JOIN Player P2
JOIN Player_Attributes PA2 ON P2.player_api_id = PA2.player_api_id
WHERE P1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
  AND P2.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
  AND PA1.date LIKE '2013-07-12%'
  AND PA2.date LIKE '2013-07-12%';

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY MAX(weight) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT SUM(M.home_team_goal) AS total_home_team_goal
FROM Player P
JOIN Match M
    ON P.player_api_id = M.home_player_1
    OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_2
    OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_3
    OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_4
    OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_5
    OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_6
    OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_7
    OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_8
    OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_9
    OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_10
    OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_11
WHERE P.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon';

SELECT SUM(m.away_team_goal)
FROM Match m
INNER JOIN Player p
    ON p.player_api_id = m.away_player_1
    OR p.player_api_id = m.away_player_2
    OR p.player_api_id = m.away_player_3
    OR p.player_api_id = m.away_player_4
    OR p.player_api_id = m.away_player_5
    OR p.player_api_id = m.away_player_6
    OR p.player_api_id = m.away_player_7
    OR p.player_api_id = m.away_player_8
    OR p.player_api_id = m.away_player_9
    OR p.player_api_id = m.away_player_10
    OR p.player_api_id = m.away_player_11
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Daan Smith', 'Filipe Ferreira');

SELECT SUM(T1.home_team_goal)
FROM Match AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2
    ON T1.home_player_1 = T2.player_api_id
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) AS INTEGER)
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.birthday) AS INTEGER) < 31;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT DISTINCT Player.player_name
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player_Attributes.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.finishing = 1
ORDER BY datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'localtime') - datetime(T1.birthday) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M
    ON P.player_api_id IN (
        M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
        M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
        M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5,
        M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country AS C
    ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
JOIN Match M ON PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_1
JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT Country.name
FROM Country
JOIN Match ON Match.country_id = Country.id
JOIN Player ON Player.player_api_id IN (
    Match.home_player_1, Match.home_player_2, Match.home_player_3, Match.home_player_4, Match.home_player_5,
    Match.home_player_6, Match.home_player_7, Match.home_player_8, Match.home_player_9, Match.home_player_10, Match.home_player_11,
    Match.away_player_1, Match.away_player_2, Match.away_player_3, Match.away_player_4, Match.away_player_5,
    Match.away_player_6, Match.away_player_7, Match.away_player_8, Match.away_player_9, Match.away_player_10, Match.away_player_11
)
GROUP BY Country.name
ORDER BY AVG(Player.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

SELECT AVG(P.height)
FROM Player P
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id = M.home_player_1
JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Italy';

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
WHERE p.height > 180
ORDER BY p.player_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Player 
WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' 
  AND birthday > '1990';

SELECT T1.jumping - T2.jumping AS jumping_difference
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2
    ON T1.id = 6 AND T2.id = 23;

SELECT P.player_api_id
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.preferred_foot = 'right'
GROUP BY P.player_api_id
ORDER BY MIN(PA.potential) ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(T1.id)
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes)
  AND T1.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%'
  AND l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT pa.sprint_speed, pa.agility, pa.acceleration
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';

SELECT TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_games
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016'
  AND League.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT MAX(M.home_team_goal) AS highest_home_team_score
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie';

SELECT T1.finishing, T1.curve
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);

SELECT L.name
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T2.team_long_name
FROM Match AS T1
JOIN Team AS T2 ON T1.away_team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
ORDER BY T1.away_team_goal DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'B');

SELECT AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
       AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
       CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT dp.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - dt.A11 AS gap
FROM disp AS dp
INNER JOIN client AS c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
INNER JOIN district AS dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, dt.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT A.account_id
FROM client C
JOIN disp D ON C.client_id = D.client_id
JOIN account A ON D.account_id = A.account_id
JOIN district T ON C.district_id = T.district_id
WHERE C.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND T.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'Owner';

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'DISPONENT'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND T2.status = 'A'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.date) = '1997'
  AND T2.amount = (
      SELECT MIN(T4.amount)
      FROM loan AS T3
      JOIN account AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id
      WHERE T4.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
        AND T3.status = 'A'
        AND STRFTIME('%Y', T3.date) = '1997'
  );

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) = 1993
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id) AS num_female_customers
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND client.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND district.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.date = (
    SELECT MIN(t2.date)
    FROM trans t2
    WHERE t2.date >= '1995-01-01' AND t2.date < '1996-01-01'
);

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE account.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND trans.balance > 3000;

SELECT client.client_id
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE card.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT T2.date
FROM trans AS T1
JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.amount = 840
  AND T1.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT account.district_id
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.date = '1994-08-25' AND loan.status = 'A';

SELECT MAX(trans.amount)
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
JOIN trans ON disp.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE card.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount AS first_transaction_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan)
  AND t.date >= a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC, t.trans_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_clients
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A2 = 'Jesenik'
  AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT d.disp_id
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 5100
  AND t.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1996';

SELECT district.A2
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND client.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT client.birth_date
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN disp ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN client ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
WHERE loan.amount = 98832
  AND loan.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS male_percentage
FROM client c
INNER JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
  AND d.A4 = (SELECT MAX(A4) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia');

SELECT
    ((t_end.balance - t_start.balance) / t_start.balance) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM
    (SELECT account_id
     FROM loan
     WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
     ORDER BY loan_id
     LIMIT 1) AS first_loan
JOIN trans AS t_start
    ON t_start.account_id = first_loan.account_id
   AND t_start.date = '1993-03-22'
JOIN trans AS t_end
    ON t_end.account_id = first_loan.account_id
   AND t_end.date = '1998-12-27';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(l.amount) AS percentage
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.amount < 100000;

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS district_region
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE YEAR(a.date) = 1993
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND di.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND YEAR(a.date) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2, d.A3
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = 4990;

SELECT l.account_id, d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000;

SELECT l.loan_id, d.A3 AS district, d.A11 AS average_salary
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT d.A2 AS district,
       ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_decin
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(*) AS num_female_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY num_female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawal_amount DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS account_holders_without_card
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
LEFT JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = dp.disp_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  AND cd.card_id IS NULL;

SELECT d.A3
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(loan.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M';

SELECT d.district_id AS branch_location, d.A2 AS district_name
FROM district d
JOIN (SELECT MAX(A13) AS max_unemployment_rate FROM district) m
  ON d.A13 = m.max_unemployment_rate;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A16 = (SELECT MAX(A16) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id)
FROM account
JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND trans.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND trans.balance < 0;

SELECT COUNT(T2.loan_id)
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND T2.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND T2.amount >= 250000
  AND T2.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.district_id = 1
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(client.client_id) AS num_male_clients
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
  AND district.district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district

    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(a2.molecule_id) AS cnt
        FROM molecule m2
        JOIN atom a2 ON m2.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'

WITH seg_min AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, MIN(ym.Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption,
           COUNT(ym.CustomerID) AS num_customers
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN seg_min AS sm ON c.Segment = sm.Segment AND ym.Consumption = sm.min_consumption
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment, total_consumption / num_customers AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
     - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS difference
UNION ALL
SELECT (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
     - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
UNION ALL
SELECT (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
     - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME');

WITH consumption AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2013 AS percentage_increase
    FROM consumption
)
SELECT Segment, percentage_increase
FROM pct
WHERE percentage_increase = (SELECT MAX(percentage_increase) FROM pct)
   OR percentage_increase = (SELECT MIN(percentage_increase) FROM pct);

JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Country.name = 'Germany';

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2
ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
ORDER BY T2.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.player_name)
FROM Player AS T1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.birthday) < '1986' AND T2.defensive_work_rate = 'high'

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')
GROUP BY T1.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(T2.crossing) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Player_Attributes.heading_accuracy
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk';
SELECT count(*) FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.height > 180 AND T2.volleys > 70;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.volleys > 70 AND T2.dribbling > 70;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match 
JOIN Country ON Match.country_id = Country.id 
WHERE Country.name = 'Belgium' 
  AND Match.season = '2008/2009';

SELECT T2.long_passing
FROM Player AS T1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
ORDER BY T1.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match AS M 
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id 
WHERE L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' 
  AND SUBSTR(M.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04';

SELECT L.name
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(T2.overall_rating) / COUNT(T2.id) FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.birthday) < '1986'

WITH ariel AS (
    SELECT PA.overall_rating
    FROM Player P
    JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
    WHERE P.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk'
    ORDER BY PA.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
paulin AS (
    SELECT PA.overall_rating
    FROM Player P
    JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
    WHERE P.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'
    ORDER BY PA.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CAST((ariel.overall_rating - paulin.overall_rating) AS REAL) / paulin.overall_rating * 100
FROM ariel, paulin;

SELECT AVG(TA.buildUpPlaySpeed)
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Heart of Midlothian';
SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Pietro Marino'
SELECT SUM(T1.crossing) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Aaron Lennox'

SELECT T.chanceCreationPassing, T.chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS T
JOIN Team AS TM ON T.team_api_id = TM.team_api_id
WHERE TM.team_long_name = 'Ajax'
ORDER BY T.chanceCreationPassing DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT pa.preferred_foot
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo';
SELECT MAX(T2.overall_rating) FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon'

SELECT AVG(M.away_team_goal) AS average_away_goals
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
JOIN Country AS C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Parma' AND C.name = 'Italy';

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = 77
  AND pa.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT PA.overall_rating
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy'
  AND PA.date LIKE '2016-02-04%';

SELECT T2.potential
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Francesco Parravicini'
  AND T2.date = '2010-08-30 00:00:00';
SELECT T2.attacking_work_rate FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore' AND T2.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT T1.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud' AND T1.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00'

SELECT T1.date
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND T1.crossing = (
      SELECT MAX(T3.crossing)
      FROM Player_Attributes AS T3
      JOIN Player AS T4 ON T3.player_api_id = T4.player_api_id
      WHERE T4.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  )
ORDER BY T1.date
LIMIT 1;

SELECT TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Willem II'
  AND TA.date = '2012-02-22';

SELECT T2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T1.team_short_name = 'LEI'
  AND T2.date = '2015-09-10 00:00:00';

SELECT T2.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T1.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND T2.date LIKE '2010-02-22%';

SELECT TA.chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'PEC Zwolle'
  AND TA.date = '2013-09-20 00:00:00';

SELECT TA.chanceCreationCrossingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hull City' AND TA.date = '2010-02-22 00:00:00'

SELECT TA.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'
  AND TA.date LIKE '2015-09-10%';

SELECT AVG(T2.overall_rating) FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' AND SUBSTR(T2.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

SELECT ((SELECT T1.overall_rating
         FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
         JOIN Player AS P1 ON T1.player_api_id = P1.player_api_id
         WHERE P1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND T1.date LIKE '2013-07-12%')
        -
        (SELECT T2.overall_rating
         FROM Player_Attributes AS T2
         JOIN Player AS P2 ON T2.player_api_id = P2.player_api_id
         WHERE P2.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' AND T2.date LIKE '2013-07-12%'))
       * 100.0
       /
       (SELECT T1.overall_rating
        FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
        JOIN Player AS P1 ON T1.player_api_id = P1.player_api_id
        WHERE P1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND T1.date LIKE '2013-07-12%') AS percentage;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player
ORDER BY weight DESC
LIMIT 10
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'localtime') - datetime(birthday) > 34

SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal)
FROM Match m
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11)
WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon';
SELECT sum(T1.away_team_goal) FROM Match AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.away_player_1 = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Daan Smith' OR T2.player_name = 'Filipe Ferreira'

WITH young_players AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    WHERE (julianday(datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - julianday(birthday)) / 365.25 < 31
)
SELECT SUM(T1.home_team_goal) AS total_home_team_goal
FROM Match AS T1
WHERE T1.home_player_1 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR T1.home_player_2 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR T1.home_player_3 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR T1.home_player_4 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR T1.home_player_5 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR T1.home_player_6 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR T1.home_player_7 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR T1.home_player_8 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR T1.home_player_9 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR T1.home_player_10 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR T1.home_player_11 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
ORDER BY PA.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.finishing = 1
ORDER BY julianday(datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - julianday(T1.birthday) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
INNER JOIN Match AS M ON P.player_api_id = M.home_player_1
INNER JOIN Country AS C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium'

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, c.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
    m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
    m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
WHERE pa.vision > 89;

SELECT C.name
FROM Country AS C
JOIN Match AS M ON C.id = M.country_id
JOIN Player AS P ON P.player_api_id IN (
    M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
    M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
    M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5,
    M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
)
GROUP BY C.name
ORDER BY AVG(P.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow'

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';
SELECT AVG(DISTINCT T1.height) FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Match AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.home_player_1 WHERE T2.country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Italy')
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990'
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23);

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'
ORDER BY potential ASC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(player_api_id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes) AND preferred_foot = 'left'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strength > 80 AND stamina > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%' AND l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT T1.sprint_speed, T1.agility, T1.acceleration
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Alexis Blin'

SELECT TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT COUNT(m.id) 
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
  AND c.name = 'Italy'
  AND l.name LIKE '%Serie A%';
SELECT MAX(T1.home_team_goal) FROM Match AS T1 JOIN League AS T2 ON T1.league_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie'

SELECT T2.finishing, T2.curve
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);

SELECT League.name, COUNT(Match.id) AS num_games
FROM League
JOIN Match ON League.id = Match.league_id
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY League.name
ORDER BY num_games DESC
LIMIT 4

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Match M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match);
SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id ORDER BY T2.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_unemployment_year FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.district_id)
FROM district AS T1
JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T2.gender = 'F' AND T1.A11 > 6000 AND T1.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM account a
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(c2.birth_date) FROM client c2 WHERE c2.gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
        FROM client c2
        JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
          AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(c3.birth_date) FROM client c3 WHERE c3.gender = 'F')
  );

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) 
FROM disp d 
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id 
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' 
  AND d.type = 'Owner';

SELECT disp.client_id
FROM disp
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND disp.type = 'Disponent';

SELECT DISTINCT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
  AND l.date LIKE '1997%'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MIN(l2.amount)
      FROM loan l2
      WHERE l2.status = 'A'
        AND l2.date LIKE '1997%'
  );

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.duration > 12
  AND T2.status = 'A'
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.date) = '1993'
ORDER BY T2.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND di.A2 = 'Sokolov'

SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM trans
WHERE date >= '1995-01-01' AND date < '1996-01-01'
  AND date = (SELECT MIN(date) FROM trans WHERE date >= '1995-01-01' AND date < '1996-01-01');

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE account.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND trans.balance > 3000;

SELECT client.client_id
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
WHERE card.issued = '1994-03-03'
SELECT account.date FROM account JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id WHERE trans.amount = 840 AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT account.district_id
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.date = '1994-08-25';

SELECT MAX(t.amount)
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount
FROM trans t
WHERE t.account_id = (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    ORDER BY l.amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
  AND t.date >= (SELECT a.date FROM account a WHERE a.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM loan ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 1))
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND dt.A2 = 'Jesenik';

SELECT disp.disp_id
FROM disp
JOIN trans ON disp.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 5100 AND trans.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1996';

SELECT d.A2
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date LIKE '1976-01-29%'

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832 AND l.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY account.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS male_client_percentage
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT CAST((t2.balance - t1.balance) AS REAL) * 100 / t1.balance
FROM trans t1
JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id
WHERE t1.date = '1993-03-22'
  AND t2.date = '1998-12-27'
  AND t1.account_id = (
      SELECT account_id
      FROM loan
      WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
        AND status = 'A'
      ORDER BY loan_id
      LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage
FROM loan;

SELECT account.account_id, district.A2 AS district_name, district.A3 AS district_region
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND strftime('%Y', account.date) = '1993';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31';

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = '4990';

SELECT account.account_id, district.A2 AS district, district.A3 AS region
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.amount > 300000;

SELECT loan.loan_id, district.A3, district.A11
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.duration = 60;

SELECT district.A2 AS district, ((district.A13 - district.A12) / district.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.status = 'D';

FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1997 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
   * 100.0
   / SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) IN (1996, 1997);

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
            THEN 'More in-patients' 
        ELSE 'More outpatients' 
    END AS Comparison,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Deviation_Percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

WITH segment_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM segment_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
averages AS (
    SELECT st.Segment, SUM(st.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(st.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM segment_totals st
    JOIN min_totals mt ON st.Segment = mt.Segment AND st.total = mt.min_total
    GROUP BY st.Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM averages;

WITH seg AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
        / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, pct
FROM seg
WHERE pct = (SELECT MAX(pct) FROM seg)
   OR pct = (SELECT MIN(pct) FROM seg)
ORDER BY pct DESC;

    JOIN target ON t.account_id = target.account_id

),

    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target ON t.account_id = target.account_id

)

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID
),
lows AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) AS tot, COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS cnt
    FROM totals t
    WHERE t.total = (SELECT MIN(t2.total) FROM totals t2 WHERE t2.Segment = t.Segment)
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT tot * 1.0 / cnt FROM lows WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT tot * 1.0 / cnt FROM lows WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT tot * 1.0 / cnt FROM lows WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT tot * 1.0 / cnt FROM lows WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM;

WITH seg AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
        / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, pct
FROM seg
WHERE pct = (SELECT MAX(pct) FROM seg)
   OR pct = (SELECT MIN(pct) FROM seg)
ORDER BY pct DESC;
