FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND PA.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT defensive_work_rate FROM Player_Attributes JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id WHERE Player.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud' AND Player_Attributes.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00'

SELECT pa.date
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND pa.crossing = (
      SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing)
      FROM Player_Attributes pa2
      JOIN Player p2 ON p2.player_api_id = pa2.player_api_id
      WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  )
ORDER BY pa.date
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T_Attributes.buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team_Attributes AS T_Attributes INNER JOIN Team AS T ON T_Attributes.team_api_id = T.team_api_id WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Willem II' AND T_Attributes.date = '2012-02-22'
SELECT TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass FROM Team_Attributes AS TA JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_fifa_api_id = T.team_fifa_api_id WHERE T.team_short_name = 'LEI' AND TA.date = '2015-09-10 00:00:00'

SELECT TA.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient'
  AND TA.date LIKE '2010-02-22%';

SELECT T_Attributes.chanceCreationPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes AS T_Attributes JOIN Team AS T ON T_Attributes.team_api_id = T.team_api_id WHERE T.team_long_name = 'PEC Zwolle' AND T_Attributes.date = '2013-09-20 00:00:00'
SELECT TA.chanceCreationCrossingClass FROM Team_Attributes AS TA JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hull City' AND TA.date = '2010-02-22 00:00:00'

SELECT Team_Attributes.defenceAggressionClass FROM Team_Attributes JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96' AND Team_Attributes.date LIKE '2015-09-10%';

SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' AND SUBSTR(T1.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

WITH ld AS (
  SELECT pa.overall_rating AS r
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%'
),
jb AS (
  SELECT pa.overall_rating AS r
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  WHERE p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%'
)
SELECT (ld.r - jb.r) * 100.0 / ld.r
FROM ld, jb;
SELECT P.player_name FROM Player AS P WHERE P.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime') - datetime(birthday) > 34;

SELECT SUM(T1.home_team_goal) FROM Match AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.home_player_1 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_2 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_3 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_4 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_5 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_6 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_7 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_8 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_9 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_10 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_11 = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon'

SELECT SUM(m.away_team_goal)
FROM Match AS m
JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id IN (m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Daan Smith', 'Filipe Ferreira');
SELECT SUM(T1.home_team_goal) FROM Match AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.home_player_1 = T2.player_api_id WHERE (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.birthday)) < 31
SELECT p.player_name FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id ORDER BY pa.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name FROM Player AS P JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE PA.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes)
SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name FROM Player P JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE PA.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.finishing = 1 ORDER BY julianday(datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'localtime')) - julianday(T1.birthday) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN Country AS C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name AS country
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (
    M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
    M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
    M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5,
    M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name FROM Country AS c JOIN (SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match) AS m ON m.country_id = c.id JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = m.player_api_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name FROM Team AS T JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow'
SELECT T.team_short_name FROM Team AS T JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'

WITH im AS (
    SELECT home_player_1 AS p1, home_player_2 AS p2, home_player_3 AS p3, home_player_4 AS p4, home_player_5 AS p5, home_player_6 AS p6, home_player_7 AS p7, home_player_8 AS p8, home_player_9 AS p9, home_player_10 AS p10, home_player_11 AS p11,
           away_player_1 AS a1, away_player_2 AS a2, away_player_3 AS a3, away_player_4 AS a4, away_player_5 AS a5, away_player_6 AS a6, away_player_7 AS a7, away_player_8 AS a8, away_player_9 AS a9, away_player_10 AS a10, away_player_11 AS a11
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
    WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
)
SELECT AVG(pl.height)
FROM Player pl
WHERE pl.player_api_id IN (
    SELECT p1 FROM im UNION SELECT p2 FROM im UNION SELECT p3 FROM im UNION SELECT p4 FROM im UNION SELECT p5 FROM im UNION SELECT p6 FROM im UNION SELECT p7 FROM im UNION SELECT p8 FROM im UNION SELECT p9 FROM im UNION SELECT p10 FROM im UNION SELECT p11 FROM im UNION
    SELECT a1 FROM im UNION SELECT a2 FROM im UNION SELECT a3 FROM im UNION SELECT a4 FROM im UNION SELECT a5 FROM im UNION SELECT a6 FROM im UNION SELECT a7 FROM im UNION SELECT a8 FROM im UNION SELECT a9 FROM im UNION SELECT a10 FROM im UNION SELECT a11 FROM im
)
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990'
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS jumping_difference
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'right' GROUP BY player_api_id ORDER BY MIN(potential) ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes) AND preferred_foot = 'left'
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strength > 80 AND stamina > 80 THEN player_api_id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS percentage FROM Player_Attributes
SELECT Country.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';
SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id WHERE m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%' AND l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'

SELECT Player_Attributes.sprint_speed, Player_Attributes.agility, Player_Attributes.acceleration FROM Player JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id WHERE Player.player_name = 'Alexis Blin'
SELECT DISTINCT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team t JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND c.name = 'Italy' AND l.name LIKE '%Serie A%';
SELECT MAX(T1.home_team_goal) FROM Match AS T1 INNER JOIN League AS T2 ON T1.league_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie'

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);
SELECT L.name FROM League L JOIN Match M ON M.league_id = L.id WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY L.name ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT T.team_long_name FROM Team AS T INNER JOIN Match AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id ORDER BY M.away_team_goal DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T.player_name FROM Player AS T INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS A ON T.player_api_id = A.player_api_id ORDER BY A.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.height < 180 AND T2.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.id) FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND d.A3 = 'East Bohemia'
SELECT COUNT(T1.account_id) FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T2.A3 = 'Prague' AND T1.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan)
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_unemployment_year FROM district
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.district_id) FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.A11 > 6000 AND d.A11 < 10000;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'M' AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND district.A11 > 8000

SELECT T3.account_id, (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - T4.A11 AS gap
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
JOIN district AS T4 ON T1.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
  AND T1.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND T4.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district)

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) FROM disp d JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND d.type = 'Owner'
SELECT c.client_id FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND d.type = 'DISPONENT'

SELECT l.account_id FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE l.status = 'C' AND strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND l.amount = (SELECT MIN(amount) FROM loan WHERE status = 'C' AND strftime('%Y', date) = '1997');

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan WHERE duration > 12)
  AND a.date LIKE '1993%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01' AND dt.A2 = 'Sokolov'
SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM trans WHERE date = (SELECT MIN(date) FROM trans WHERE date LIKE '95%')

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01' AND t.balance > 3000;
SELECT c.client_id FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id WHERE cd.issued = '1994-03-03';
SELECT account.date FROM trans JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id WHERE trans.amount = 840 AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT T2.district_id
FROM loan AS T1
JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.date = '1994-08-25' AND T1.status = 'C';
SELECT MAX(t.amount) FROM trans t JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id WHERE di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT t.amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM loan ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 1)
  AND t.date > a.date
ORDER BY t.date, t.trans_id
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id WHERE dt.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND c.gender = 'F'
SELECT disp.disp_id FROM disp JOIN trans ON disp.account_id = trans.account_id WHERE trans.amount = 5100 AND trans.date = '1998-09-02'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice' AND strftime('%Y', account.date) = '1996';

SELECT district.A2 FROM client JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'F' AND client.birth_date = '1976-01-29'

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832 AND l.date = '1996-01-03'
LIMIT 1;
SELECT account.account_id FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague' ORDER BY account.date ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS male_percentage
FROM client
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT ((t2.balance - t1.balance) * 100.0 / t1.balance) AS increase_rate
FROM trans t1
JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id
WHERE t1.account_id = (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
)
AND t1.date = '1993-03-22'
AND t2.date = '1998-12-27';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage FROM loan
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) FROM loan WHERE amount < 100000;

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2, d.A3
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;
SELECT account_id, date FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice'
SELECT district.A2, district.A3 FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.loan_id = 4990
SELECT l.account_id, d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount > 300000;

SELECT l.loan_id, d.A2 AS district, d.A11 AS average_salary
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2 AS district, ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';
SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(*) AS num_female_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY num_female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT d.A2, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%' GROUP BY d.A2 ORDER BY total_withdrawal DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disp d JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND di.A3 = 'South Bohemia' AND d.disp_id NOT IN (SELECT disp_id FROM card);
SELECT d.A3 FROM district d JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D') GROUP BY d.A3 ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(l.amount) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT d.account_id FROM disp d JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.gender = 'M');
SELECT district_id, A2 FROM district WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district ORDER BY CAST(A16 AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id)
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.balance < 0
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.date BETWEEN '950101' AND '971231'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D') AND a.district_id = 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client WHERE gender = 'M' AND district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district ORDER BY A15 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Pisek'

SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.A2
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000
  AND t.date LIKE '1997%';
SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO' AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';
SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM disp JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id WHERE card.type = 'gold';

SELECT AVG(monthly_amount) AS avg_monthly_amount
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS monthly_amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2021'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date)
);

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM disp d
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'
  AND t.amount < (
      SELECT AVG(amount)
      FROM trans
      WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
        AND strftime('%Y', date) = '1998'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT cl.client_id
FROM client cl
JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE cl.gender = 'F';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND LOWER(di.A3) = 'south bohemia';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp ON disp.account_id = a.account_id

WITH base AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           ym.Consumption AS Consumption,
           MIN(ym.Consumption) OVER (PARTITION BY c.Segment) AS min_cons
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' AND Consumption = min_cons THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)
      / SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' AND Consumption = min_cons THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' AND Consumption = min_cons THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)
      / SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' AND Consumption = min_cons THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference_SME_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' AND Consumption = min_cons THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)
      / SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' AND Consumption = min_cons THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' AND Consumption = min_cons THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)
      / SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' AND Consumption = min_cons THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference_LAM_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' AND Consumption = min_cons THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)
      / SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' AND Consumption = min_cons THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' AND Consumption = min_cons THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)
      / SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' AND Consumption = min_cons THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference_KAM_SME
FROM base;

       SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'LAM' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'KAM' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'KAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
       SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'KAM' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'KAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'SME' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

SELECT c.Segment,
       SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Consumption2012,
       SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Consumption2013,
       (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
       SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS PercentageIncrease
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY PercentageIncrease DESC;

JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.height <= T2.height
GROUP BY T1.id, T1.player_name
HAVING MAX(T2.height) = T1.height;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player
ORDER BY weight DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'localtime') - datetime(T1.birthday) > 34

SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal)
FROM Match m
JOIN Player p ON (m.home_player_1 = p.player_api_id
               OR m.home_player_2 = p.player_api_id
               OR m.home_player_3 = p.player_api_id
               OR m.home_player_4 = p.player_api_id
               OR m.home_player_5 = p.player_api_id
               OR m.home_player_6 = p.player_api_id
               OR m.home_player_7 = p.player_api_id
               OR m.home_player_8 = p.player_api_id
               OR m.home_player_9 = p.player_api_id
               OR m.home_player_10 = p.player_api_id
               OR m.home_player_11 = p.player_api_id)
WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon'

SELECT SUM(m.away_team_goal)
FROM Match AS m
JOIN Player AS p
  ON p.player_api_id IN (m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Daan Smith', 'Filipe Ferreira');

SELECT SUM(T1.home_team_goal) FROM Match AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.home_player_1 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_2 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_3 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_4 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_5 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_6 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_7 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_8 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_9 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_10 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_11 = T2.player_api_id WHERE (strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(T2.birthday))) <= 30
SELECT P.player_name FROM Player P JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id ORDER BY PA.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
ORDER BY pa.potential DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE PA.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT T2.player_name
FROM Player AS T2
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T1 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.finishing = 1
ORDER BY julianday(datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - julianday(T2.birthday) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id = M.home_player_1 OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_2 OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_3 OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_4 OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_5 OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_6 OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_7 OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_8 OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_9 OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_10 OR P.player_api_id = M.home_player_11 OR P.player_api_id = M.away_player_1 OR P.player_api_id = M.away_player_2 OR P.player_api_id = M.away_player_3 OR P.player_api_id = M.away_player_4 OR P.player_api_id = M.away_player_5 OR P.player_api_id = M.away_player_6 OR P.player_api_id = M.away_player_7 OR P.player_api_id = M.away_player_8 OR P.player_api_id = M.away_player_9 OR P.player_api_id = M.away_player_10 OR P.player_api_id = M.away_player_11
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Country C ON L.country_id = C.id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name
FROM Country c
JOIN Match m ON m.country_id = c.id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
    m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
    m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
)
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
ORDER BY P.player_name ASC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990';

SELECT p1.jumping - p2.jumping
FROM Player_Attributes p1
JOIN Player_Attributes p2 ON p2.id = 23
WHERE p1.id = 6;

SELECT Player.player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player_Attributes.preferred_foot = 'right'
ORDER BY Player_Attributes.potential ASC
LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left');

SELECT c.name
FROM League l
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE l.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT ht.team_long_name AS home_team, m.home_team_goal, at.team_long_name AS away_team, m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team ht ON m.home_team_api_id = ht.team_api_id
JOIN Team at ON m.away_team_api_id = at.team_api_id
WHERE m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%' AND l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT pa.sprint_speed, pa.agility, pa.acceleration
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Alexis Blin'

SELECT DISTINCT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A' AND Match.season = '2015/2016';

SELECT MAX(T1.home_team_goal) FROM Match AS T1 JOIN League AS T2 ON T1.league_id = T2.id JOIN Country AS T3 ON T2.country_id = T3.id WHERE T2.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie' AND T3.name = 'Netherlands'

SELECT PA.finishing, PA.curve
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
ORDER BY P.weight DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT League.name, COUNT(Match.id) AS num_games
FROM League
JOIN Match ON League.id = Match.league_id
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY League.name
ORDER BY num_games DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Match AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
ORDER BY M.away_team_goal DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
ORDER BY PA.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague';
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_unemployment_year FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id) FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'M' AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND district.A11 > 8000

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, dHigh.A11 - dLow.A11 AS salary_gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district dLow ON dLow.district_id = c.district_id
LEFT JOIN client cOlder ON cOlder.gender = 'F' AND cOlder.birth_date < c.birth_date
LEFT JOIN district dLower ON dLower.A11 < dLow.A11
CROSS JOIN district dHigh
LEFT JOIN district dHigher ON dHigher.A11 > dHigh.A11
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND cOlder.client_id IS NULL
  AND dLower.district_id IS NULL
  AND dHigher.district_id IS NULL

SELECT a.account_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
LEFT JOIN client c2 ON c2.birth_date > c.birth_date
LEFT JOIN district di2 ON di2.A11 > di.A11
WHERE c2.client_id IS NULL
  AND di2.district_id IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id)
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'Owner';

SELECT DISTINCT client.client_id
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE disp.type = 'DISPONENT'
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND T2.status IN ('A', 'C')
  AND T2.date LIKE '1997%'
ORDER BY T2.amount ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.account_id, l.amount
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND a.date LIKE '1993%'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov'

SELECT account_id
FROM trans
WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995'
  AND date = (SELECT MIN(date) FROM trans WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995')

SELECT DISTINCT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.date < '1997-01-01' AND T2.amount > 3000;

SELECT c.client_id
FROM card ca
JOIN disp d ON ca.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE ca.issued LIKE '1994-03-03%'

SELECT a.date
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 840 AND t.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT d.district_id
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.date = '1994-08-25' AND l.status = 'A';

SELECT MAX(trans.amount)
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN trans ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE card.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d1 ON a.district_id = d1.district_id
LEFT JOIN district d2 ON CAST(d2.A11 AS REAL) > CAST(d1.A11 AS REAL)
WHERE d2.district_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.date >= a.date
ORDER BY l.amount DESC, t.date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND c.gender = 'F'

SELECT d.disp_id
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 5100 AND t.date = '1998-09-02'

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND a.date LIKE '1996%';

SELECT district.A2
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F' AND client.birth_date LIKE '1976-01-29%'

SELECT client.birth_date
FROM loan
JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE loan.amount = 98832 AND loan.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage_male
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE LOWER(d.A3) = 'south bohemia'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A4
ORDER BY CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ((t2.balance - t1.balance) * 100.0 / t1.balance) AS increase_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN trans t1 ON t1.account_id = l.account_id AND t1.date = '1993-03-22'
JOIN trans t2 ON t2.account_id = l.account_id AND t2.date = '1998-12-27'
WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
ORDER BY l.loan_id
LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(l.amount) AS percentage FROM loan l

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2, d.A3
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND a.date LIKE '1993%';

SELECT client.client_id, account.account_id, account.frequency
FROM account
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE account.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31'
  AND district.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2, d.A3
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = 4990;

SELECT l.account_id, d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000;

SELECT l.loan_id, d.A3, d.A11
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2, ((d.A13 - d.A12) * 100.0 / d.A12) AS unemployment_increment
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';
SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT district.A2, COUNT(client.client_id) AS num_female_holders
FROM disp
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY district.A2
ORDER BY num_female_holders DESC
LIMIT 9

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
LEFT JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND card.card_id IS NULL;

SELECT d.A3 AS district
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(l.amount)
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT d1.A3 AS branch_location, d1.A2 AS district_name
FROM district d1
LEFT JOIN district d2 ON CAST(d2.A13 AS REAL) > CAST(d1.A13 AS REAL)
WHERE d2.district_id IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A16
ORDER BY d.A16 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id)
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.balance < 0
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id)
FROM loan AS l
INNER JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND a.district_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN district d2 ON d2.A15 > d.A15
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
GROUP BY d.district_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d2.district_id) = 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Pisek'

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2 AS district
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1997';

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM "order"
JOIN account ON "order".account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Pisek' AND "order".k_symbol = 'SIPO'

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT AVG(monthly_total) AS avg_monthly_credit_card_amount
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%m', date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2021'
    GROUP BY strftime('%m', date)
) AS monthly_sums;

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN trans t2 ON t2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'
  AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) = '1998'
GROUP BY c.client_id, t.trans_id, t.amount
HAVING t.amount < AVG(t2.amount);

JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id

FROM atom a

LEFT JOIN connected c2 ON a.atom_id = c2.atom_id2
WHERE c1.atom_id IS NULL AND c2.atom_id2 IS NULL;

SELECT m.molecule_id

WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '

LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT 100.0 * COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a1.element, a2.element) / COUNT(*) OVER () AS percentage
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
ORDER BY percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT z.city, z.county
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN income i ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
GROUP BY e.event_id, z.city, z.county
HAVING COUNT(i.income_id) > 40;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(e.cost) AS total_paid
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
JOIN event ev ON ev.event_id = b.link_to_event
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ev.event_id) > 1
ORDER BY total_paid DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN expense x ON b.budget_id = x.link_to_budget
JOIN budget b2 ON b2.category = 'Parking'
JOIN expense x2 ON x2.link_to_budget = b2.budget_id
JOIN event e2 ON e2.event_id = b2.link_to_event
WHERE b.category = 'Parking'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, x.expense_id, x.cost
HAVING x.cost < SUM(x2.cost) / COUNT(e2.event_id);

SELECT (SELECT SUM(cost)
        FROM expense
        WHERE link_to_budget IN (SELECT budget_id
                                 FROM budget
                                 WHERE link_to_event IN (SELECT event_id
                                                         FROM event

       (SELECT COUNT(event_id)
        FROM event
        WHERE type = 'Meeting')

            SELECT bond_id,

SELECT m.* FROM atom a1 JOIN atom a2 ON a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id JOIN molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND molecule.label = '+'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS percentage
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND atom.element = 'n'
SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's' AND atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected WHERE bond_id IN (SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '='));

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.atom_id) > 5

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '=' AND b.molecule_id = 'TR024';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(atom.molecule_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN a.molecule_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'h' AND a2.element = 'h' AND b.bond_type = '#';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'

SELECT atom.element FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR004_7' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT T1.element, T2.bond_type
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR002'

SELECT a.atom_id
